paragraphs: The new Beats 350 sports a feature the Apple-owned audio brand hasn’t offered before: interchangeable ear and headband cushions to let users change the look and feel of the over-ear headphones.

“Beats didn’t just participate in the rise of over-ear headphones — we helped define the category,” said Oliver Schusser, Apple’s vice president of Music, Sports and Beats. “Beats 360 is the next chapter of that story. We combined our most advanced acoustic performance ever with a perfectly balanced design that moves effortlessly with you. And with our new interchangeable cushions, our customers can express themselves in a way no other over-ear headphone can.”

Beats has made over-ear headphones since its earliest days. The company launched the original Beats by Dr. Dre Studio headphones in 2008, helping establish its reputation with large, bass-heavy headphones aimed at music fans. The new Beats 360 continues that over-ear tradition.
The interchangeable cushions are the headline feature. Beats 360 comes with Performance Knit earcup and headband cushions that come in black, cloud, pink, sky, navy and volt.

“Performance Knit cushions are crafted from plush memory foam and wrapped in a breathable knit for a light, airy feel, with each diamond-knit strand constructed from 36 strong micro-threads for added durability and long-term resilience,” promises Apple.
Additional kits are available separately. An UltraPlush option made of “seamless engineered leather” comes in black and cloud.
In addition, Beats 360 is the first over-ear headphone in this product line with sweat and water resistance.

Beats 360 features a completely new acoustic architecture with custom-designed drivers. Each driver uses a three-layer diaphragm and dual neodymium magnets, designed to provide powerful bass, precision and low distortion.
